notes.title: Trashcan Simulator v1.1
notes.content:
[h2]New Additions[/h2]
A new mystery has been added! Along with this, a new achievement has been introduced!
If you've unlocked all previous achievements, you should notice a change in the game!

[h2]Changes[/h2]
It has been made clear that there are hidden achievements, and that new features are added with the unlocking of these achievements.
The game has been optimized for better performance.


We would like to thank those who provided feedback regarding the improvements. Thank you!
Please continue to share your thoughts, suggestions, and bug reports on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FFacish_hum]the author's X account[/url] or on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3441140/discussions/?snr=1_5_9_]the Steam community board[/url].

notes.title: Trashcan Simulator Released!
notes.content:
Trashcan Simulator was released today!

This game recreates the everyday scene of throwing trash into a trash can, and you can enjoy it to your heart's content.
Even if you want to take it easy, you can relax by gazing at the trash can.
Enjoy your time facing the trash can to your heart's content.

If you have any comments, requests, or bugs about this game, please let us know on the [url=https://x.com/Facish_hum]author's X account[/url] or on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3441140/discussions/]Steam Community message board[/url].
